claim: Conditional deletion of Ano1 (Tmem16a) in mice disrupts Ca2+ waves within Kölliker's organ.
source: Here, we show that conditional deletion of Ano1 (Tmem16a) in mice disrupts Ca2+ waves within Kölliker's organ, reduces the burst-firing activity and the frequency selectivity of auditory brainstem neurons in the medial nucleus of the trapezoid body (MNTB), and also impairs the functional refinement of MNTB projections to the lateral superior olive.
evidence: This claim is supported by experimental data presented in the manuscript, specifically Ca2+ imaging experiments shown in Figure 1E-J.

claim: Conditional deletion of Ano1 reduces the frequency selectivity of auditory brainstem neurons in the MNTB.

evidence: This claim is supported by multiple citations to published literature.
